messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — we need a partner compatibility plan for the upcoming API change that removes the legacy batch param (batch=true). This affects marketplace listings and some hardware partners who rely on batch semantics. Can we line up a short rollback + shim plan by EOD tomorrow?

kai: +1. Propose a feature-flagged shim endpoint we can run behind the scenes for 30d. lightweight, route-based. Example:

```json
{
  "route": "/v1/partners/legacy-batch",
  "compat_flag": "enable_legacy_batch_shim",
  "timeout_ms": 50
}
```

lina: Agree with the shim idea. Also need to ensure hardware partners (EdgeAccel, OnPremBox) can pin model hashes and kernel profiles — they can't tolerate silent behavioural changes. Recommend a 90-day pinning window for hardware images + marketplace note.

ben: For SDKs: we should publish a compat shim package for partner SDKs (npm/pypi) and a short migration guide. Canary plan: 1) internal tests, 2) partner canary (EdgeAccel only), 3) marketplace-wide rollout. Target: canary start in 3 days.

alex: FYI EdgeAccel asked for a 60-day grace window last week. They'll need a pinned docker image + a compatibility header they can set from their side. I'll loop in their partner eng and get confirmation.

maya: Action list (owners):
- kai: implement flaggable shim + doc snippet (deadline: +48h)
- ben: publish compat shim SDK packages + migration guide (deadline: +72h)
- alex: confirm partner grace windows, collect list of pinned-images needed (deadline: +24h)
- lina: update marketplace listing checklist and compliance note (deadline: +48h)

Also need comms: short partner-facing notice + internal readiness matrix.

deploy-bot: Canary job created: canary/shim-deploy-2026-03-21 on canary-3. Status: queued.

kai: I'll add metrics hooks (error-rate, latency delta, prefixed tokens) to the shim and a quick grafana dashboard. Will drop a monitoring link once live.

ben: Draft for partner notice (short):
"We're rolling out an API simplification that removes legacy batch parameters. Partners on legacy batch routes will be routed to a compatibility shim for a limited grace period. Please pin runtime artifacts and follow the migration guide published in Marketplace > Integrations."

maya: Nice — can you expand that to a one-paragraph with timelines and an ops contact? I'll send to partner PMs after review.

ben: on it, will post the draft here by EOD. :thumbsup:

alex: hitting this now with EdgeAccel — expect reply with pinned-image names by EOD.

maya: Great. If anyone sees a blocker (legal/regulatory for pinned images), flag here ASAP. Otherwise we'll treat this as priority P0 for partner stability. :eyes:
